new_entities.name: Extended-release methylphenidate in adults
new_entities.description: Long-acting methylphenidate formulations used for adults with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder.

new_entities.name: Adult ADHD severity
new_entities.description: Severity of adult ADHD symptoms on clinician-rated or self-rated ADHD scales.

edges.effect_quant: The most direct adult extended-release synthesis is the 2022 Cochrane review, which found that extended-release methylphenidate reduced self-rated ADHD symptoms versus placebo across 24 trials in 5,066 adults, with individual adult randomized trials also showing clinically meaningful symptom drops.
edges.population: adults with formal attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder diagnoses treated with extended-release methylphenidate formulations
edges.mechanism: Extended-release methylphenidate increases synaptic dopamine and norepinephrine across the day, which can improve sustained attention, inhibitory control, and task persistence while reducing distractibility and impulsive responding.
edges.summary: The adult evidence base is strong enough to treat this as a real efficacy edge. Extended-release methylphenidate consistently improves adult ADHD symptom severity compared with placebo, including in individualized-dose and laboratory-classroom designs.
edges.caveats: The literature is cleaner for short-term symptom control than for long-term functional outcomes, and many trials exclude substantial psychiatric comorbidity. Benefit also has to be balanced against appetite, sleep, pulse, and blood-pressure effects in real-world prescribing.

evidence.citation: BoesenK et al 2022 Cochrane Database Syst Rev
evidence.notes: Extended-release methylphenidate for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in adults.

effect_quant.comparator: extended-release methylphenidate versus placebo on self-rated and investigator-rated adult ADHD symptom scales across randomized trials

evidence.citation: WeissMD et al 2021 J Atten Disord
evidence.notes: Efficacy and Safety of PRC-063, Extended-Release Multilayer Methylphenidate in Adults with ADHD Including 6-Month Open-Label Extension.
